verdict.rationale: Quo ships Sona, a built-in AI agent that takes over call answering when the team is unavailable, captures details and hands conversations back, and it also auto-summarizes and tags calls. That is genuine in-product delegation, but only for one narrow task. The Claude/ChatGPT connectors and the MCP server rely on external agents, so they are not counted as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant users can delegate arbitrary tasks to (texting, contact updates, inbox triage), in-depth docs on Sona's configuration and capabilities, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
This endpoint supports summaries for both regular calls and calls handled by Sona.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
